 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+This project uses [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/). Install it and run the
+suite from the repository root:
+
+```sh
+pip install pytest
+pytest
+```
+
+To run a single file or a single test:
+
+```sh
+pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py
+pytest tests/test_pricing_cache.py::test_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
+
+Note: no tests have been written yet, so `pytest` currently collects zero
+tests. Add test modules under `tests/` named `test_*.py`.
